### problem_chain

Walk from the root:

1. Root: the customer asks to have the repair recorded as authorized and to hear the planned days (persona: "you want the repair authorized and to know how long it will take"). Policy: claim_ext_authorization_repair_days, write `record_insurer_authorization_cee3bb86` (agent).
2. Prerequisite sentence in its rule: "The planned repair days are fixed only after every customer-pay addition consent issued on the repair order stands signed or revoked." At `frozen_time`: `claim_consents.0d78a10c` (`consent_type: customer_pay_addition`, `addition_kind: unrelated_damage`, `consent_status: pending_customer`, `labor_hours: 3.4`, `requested_at: 2026-10-05 11:05:33 EDT`) -> false at the opening.
3. Which write makes it true: its `addition_kind` is unrelated_damage; the rule "An unrelated-damage addition is priced when its customer-pay addition consent is signed ..." (claim_ext_unrelated_addition_price) prices it, and `sign_unrelated_damage_addition_ef94c675` (owner=user) is the write. Revocation has no tool, and the persona closes it ("you still want them to fix the scrape ... and you do not want to cancel it"). The other consents on the order are all signed. No other kind is pending, so the hop is unique (cf. O-3).
4. claim_ext_unrelated_addition_price has `prerequisite: []`, and nothing it reads is false-pending: its inputs are present.

Derived tree: authorization_repair_days --value_input(a_addition_hours)--> unrelated_addition_price. n = 1 prerequisite problem, 1 value_input edge (floor max(0,1) = 1), no cycle. Topological order: (1) customer signs `0d78a10c` at the price, (2) agent records authorization.

- Customer's own write in the tree: yes - `sign_unrelated_damage_addition_ef94c675`, handed over passively ("When the agent hands you the step to sign that form yourself, you run it with the reference number and the price the agent gives you").
- Load-bearing run (skip the signature, replay the rest): signed customer-pay hours 1.2 instead of 4.6, plan 18.7 instead of 22.1, production days ceil(18.7/6.5) = 3 instead of 4 -> **8 planned days instead of 9**. Edge bears weight.
- Parallel edges: none.
- No wait: the signature is the customer's immediate act in the call.
- Tool layer: `record_insurer_authorization_cee3bb86` reads only `original_estimate_usd` and writes; it never reads consents. `sign_unrelated_damage_addition_ef94c675` writes the consent with no check. The tools judge no prerequisite.
- Persona raises only the root: the scrape form is mentioned only "if the agent brings up the separate customer-pay form"; no "do I need to sort something out first". No other ask (no quote, rental or transfer). The persona closes when the agent gives the authorization and the planned days - matching the last write of the tree.

## findings

- T0-F1 SOURCE-FACTOR RED - symptom: the planned-repair-days computation has no factor whose tier changes the algorithm. Root cause: hidden_damage_allowance is a rate substitution labelled `method`. Evidence: rule "a Photo Estimate raises them by the photo allowance percentage, a Drive-In, Scheduled or Mobile Estimate raises them by the inspected allowance percentage, and a repair order converted from any other estimate type ... keeps them as written"; params `photo_allowance_pct: 20`, `inspected_allowance_pct: 10`; on this world 14.6 -> 17.5 / 16.1 / 14.6. Consequence: method count 0 < 1. Affected: `claim.extended.yaml` claim_ext_authorization_repair_days `factors[0].effect`; `computations[1]`. Relation to previous revisions: first audit.
- T0-F2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED - symptom: production_daily_hours' structural-supplement condition divides no customer. Root cause and evidence: `_difficulty.md` F-3 (lifecycle `assigned -> authorized`; supplement eligibility "authorized, in_repair or on_hold"). Consequence on this world: `claim_supplements` is empty, as it must be at any authorization; the tier is decided by plan size alone; GT labels the factor multi-source. Affected: rule daily-hours sentence; `factors[1]`; `computations[1].factor_trace[1]`. First audit.
- T0-F3 SOURCE-FACTOR RED - symptom: addition_scope_rate's collision tier is unreachable. Root cause and evidence: `_difficulty.md` F-2 (inherited unrelated-hours cap <= 8.0 vs a > 24.0 h tier). Consequence: two-tier factor; on this world it still bears weight (285.97 vs 260.13). Affected: claim_ext_unrelated_addition_price rule and `factors[0]`. First audit.
- Observations T0-O1..O3 as frozen above; charter observations O-1..O-11 in `_difficulty.md`.
